AUTTAINE GUNSLINGER/INVESTIGATOR/ROGUE
CR 13

XP 25,600
Auttaine gunslinger 1/investigator 9/rogue 4
N Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +7; Senses Perception +19

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+3 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 111 (14 HD; 13d8+1d10+37)
Fort +8, Ref +15, Will +9; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue., +1 vs. ingested poisons, +4 vs. nauseated or sickened, +6 bonus vs. poison
Defensive Abilities evasion, trap sense +4, uncanny dodge; Resist construct resistances, poison resistance

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 adamantine rapier +12/+7 (1d6+2/18–20)
Ranged +1 distance dragon pistol +14 (1d6+1/x4) or masterwork shotgun +14 (1d8+3/19–20)
Special Attacks deeds (deadeye, gunslinger’s dodge, quick clear), grit (2), gun training +3 (shotgun), sneak attack +3d6, studied combat (+4, 3 rounds), studied strike +3d6
Investigator Extracts Prepared (CL 9th; concentration +12)

3rd—blood scent, burst of speed, gaseous form, haste
2nd—aid, barkskin, blur, cure moderate wounds, invisibility
1st—disguise self, longshot, monkey fish, stone fist, true strike, urban grace

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 16, Con 15, Int 16, Wis 15, Cha 17
Base Atk +10; CMB +10; CMD 23
Feats Accomplished Sneak Attacker, Barroom Brawler, Cosmopolitan, Deadly Aim, Gunsmithing, Improved Critical (shotgun), Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot
Skills Bluff +20, Diplomacy +20, Disguise +13, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (engineering) +13, Knowledge (geography) +13, Knowledge (history) +12, Linguistics +12, Perception +19, Profession (merchant) +8, Profession (sailor) +7, Sense Motive +19, Sleight of Hand +13, Stealth +13, Survival +12
Languages Common Dwarven, Giant, Undercommon
SQ alchemy (alchemy crafting +9), construct points, inspiration (7/day), investigator talents (charmer, coax information, iron guts, ledge walker), keen recollection, poison lore, rogue talents (false friend, surprise attacks), swift alchemy, trapfinding +6
Gear +1 leather armor, +1 distance dragon pistol held in a bone and leather holster worked with clockwork fish figurines worth 250 gp, +2 adamantine rapier, masterwork shotgun; Other Gear long welder’s coat containing deep pockets within which are a silk purse containing 200 gp, hidden compartment contains a potion of cure serious wounds in a steel-stoppered bottle, and a tiny gold and pewter tiger-like figure gripping a rock worth 250 gp.
